name: Low-Rank Constrained NeRF (LR-NeRF)
definition: An optimization step where the simplified NeRF weights are finetuned under a low-rank constraint using the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) to prepare for Tensor Train decomposition.
summary: LR-NeRF is a weight regularization technique that enforces low-rank structure on NeRF parameters via ADMM to facilitate efficient compression through Tensor Train decomposition and quantization.
